items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially didn’t practice for a second straight day due to his hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring injury continuing; second straight DNP.
items.implication: Likely OUT or highly questionable for Week 7 vs SEA; monitor Friday.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for Xavier Worthy and other KC WRs.

items.text: Breece Hall back to practice… (per Jets Thursday injury report).
items.why: Quad injury; returned after multiple DNPs and missed games.
items.implication: Progress toward possible ACTIVE/GTD for Week 7 vs MIA; still monitor full status.
items.opportunity: If plays, full RB1 role; if limited/out, Braelon Allen continues lead.

items.text: Seahawks also activated running back Zach Charbonnet from the physically unable to perform list. (Alongside Arroyo season-ending surgery).
items.why: Activated from PUP; significant move per reports.
items.implication: Charbonnet returns to RB rotation; impacts depth chart immediately.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/lead share potential; reduces Jadarian Price upside further.

items.text: Source: Seahawks TE Elijah Arroyo is undergoing shoulder surgery today and will miss the rest of the season.
items.implication: SEA TE depth thinned for ROS.
items.opportunity: Potential bump for other SEA pass-catchers/TEs.

items.text: Buccaneers listed QB Baker Mayfield as a full participant in today’s practice.
items.implication: Expected to play/start Week 7; positive for TB offense pace.
items.opportunity: Boosts Bucky Irving, Emeka Egbuka, Chris Godwin usage if healthy.

items.text: Bears ruled out RB Kyle Monangai for Thursday night’s game vs. the Patriots. Monangai now will miss his third straight game due to his thumb injury and turf toe.
items.why: Thumb and turf toe; third straight miss.
items.implication: Bears RB depth thinner for TNF; Swift primary.
items.opportunity: Elevated role/snaps for D'Andre Swift and any backups.

items.text: Notable update here, as Terrance Ferguson was going to be the biggest beneficiary of the Davante Adams injury. Rams' only answer now is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Ferguson (eligible off IR) recovery 'will take some time' per Schefter source; Adams out 6-10 weeks hamstring.
items.implication: Puka locked as massive target hog ROS/Week 7 vs LV.
items.opportunity: Elite target share, routes, red-zone; no TE competition soon.

items.text: Chiefs now have officially placed OT Josh Simmons on injured reserve.
items.why: Bulging disc; plateaued in rehab per trainer.
items.implication: OL depth hit for KC; impacts protection for Mahomes/Rice return timeline.

items.text: Worth noting that Josh Jacobs was allowed to be in team meetings at the facility, lifting sessions, medical treatments, any other non-football activities. Also note MarShawn Lloyd (49th in EPA/rush among 54 qualifiers) and Kaleb Johnson (53rd) have been quite bad.
items.why: Jacobs facility access (non-practice); backups poor EPA. OL mess.
items.implication: Jacobs long-term outlook discussed on ROS show; backups not filling well.
items.opportunity: If Jacobs limited, no strong handcuff upside yet.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10). Bears good place for yardage; Brown back in real role.
Loves DeVonta Smith vs. DAL (WR11). Elite volume.
items.opportunity: High target share with Hurts out context.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs. NE (WR32). Nasty matchup and role issues.
Up in pace: TB @ CAR. Slow paced slogs: MIA @ NYJ. Full Week 7 Snaps & Pace from Pat Thorman notes high volume potential for TB/CAR, GB/DET, LAR/LV.
items.why: Neutral pace/PROE data; TB speeding up with Mayfield return potential, CAR high volume.
items.implication: Prefer players in up-pace games for snap/opportunity edge.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/routes/carries in TB/CAR, GB/DET, LAR/LV.

items.text: Different scheme. Different coaches. Small sample. Always want to leave room for players to improve. But tough to get it out of my head. Yards per target when throwing at Justin Jefferson: ... 5. JJ McCarthy 5.7 (vs others 9.9-10.8).
items.why: Giants plan to start JJ McCarthy; historical YPT data poor with him.
items.implication: Caution on Jefferson efficiency/ROS with McCarthy under center.
